reason: The analyst's 'no effect' rests on one unjustified specification: the north-only subsample (about a third of firms), a trim on the outcome, and a reduced set of controls. I re-ran the full-sample model with all pre-period controls and got 0.75 (SE 0.23, p=0.001). North is the region with the smallest effect (0.30, SE 0.42), while central gives 0.80 and south 1.12. The null is therefore a subgroup artifact that is underpowered rather than evidence of no effect.
